data.exact_reserve_text: In 2015, there has been an overall surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 0.6m (2014:GBP 3.8m) due primarily to a reduction in claims estimates as uncertainty around catastrophe exposure unwinds. 2014 included a reduction in respect of reserves required for Superstorm Sandy.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Reduction in reserves required related to Superstorm Sandy, contributing to favourable development in prior years.
Large reduction in gross claims outstanding due to the commutation of the 2012 year of account into Syndicate 2791.

named_events.loss_description: Reduction in respect of reserves required for Superstorm Sandy (not separately quantified).

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2015 gross claims outstanding were GBP 5.119m. During 2015 the syndicate recorded an overall favourable development (a release) in prior years' ultimate claims of GBP 0.6m, driven primarily by reductions in claims estimates as uncertainty around catastrophe exposure unwound, including a reduction relating to Superstorm Sandy. The 2012 year was also materially affected by a commutation (RITC) into Syndicate 2791 which reduced gross claims outstanding by c.GBP 4.25m.
raw_causal_phrases: overall surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 0.6m (2014:GBP 3.8m)
due primarily to a reduction in claims estimates as uncertainty around catastrophe exposure unwinds
2014 included a reduction in respect of reserves required for Superstorm Sandy
The movement in the net provisions for claims includes a release of GBP 0.3m (2014: GBP 1.7m).
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure derived from narrative statement and claims development commentary (explicit 'overall surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 0.6m') rather than a labelled 'movement in prior year provision' gross column. Large RITC commutation (2012 YOA) materially reduced gross claims outstanding (explicit GBP 4.25k in note) which distorts simple reserve movement interpretation. Gross premium mix is sparse - only 'Property reinsurance' is explicitly reported as the syndicate's class; therefore a single-class mix is provided.
